topic: feelings (happy, sad, sleepy, surprised) and being kind
title: Feelings and Kindness with Pip, Lulu, and Bo
yt_description:
This sweet song helps toddlers recognize feelings like happy, sad, sleepy, and surprised. It also teaches the joy of being kind to friends.

🎵 Feelings and Kindness with Pip, Lulu, and Bo

Hello friends, let's sing today
Feelings show in every way

Happy Pip is jumping high
Lulu smiles, her ears fly by
Bo feels sleepy, time for rest
Kindness helps us all feel best

Feelings come, feelings go
Tell your friends, let kindness show
Happy, sad, or surprised too
Being kind is what we do

Sad Lulu needs a hug
Bo is surprised by a bug
Pip is happy, claps his paws
Kindness spreads without a pause

Feelings come, feelings go
Tell your friends, let kindness show
Happy, sad, or surprised too
Being kind is what we do

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
